snippet.title: THAT TIME I GOT REINCARNATED AS AN AUTONOMOUS ROBOTIC VACUUM CLEANER | ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
After an unfortunate car accident, you find yourself in the presence of God. He offers you a deal; you watch his friend's house for a week, and you get to reincarnate as anything you want for your next life!

It isn't until after you agree to the deal that the catch is revealed... The house is haunted.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4073730/THAT_TIME_I_GOT_REINCARNATED_AS_AN_AUTONOMOUS_ROBOTIC_VACUUM_CLEANER/

Voice Acting by TJ Karagosian - @TimKaragosian 
Music: Our Time Is Short by Nihilore - https://www.nihilore.com/
